div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://fhir-fli.dev/bumblebee/CodeSystem/treatment-level-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Needs general anaesthesia and/or hospitalisation. Requires a Type 2 or Type 3 team.
Treatable in the emergency room as an outpatient, but needs conscious sedation or a regional block.
First aid and light dressing, no anaesthesia. Within Type 1 mobile capability.
